canonical_predecessor.relationship: This decision cites the closure; it does not reopen, amend, replace, or reuse the prior authorization.

why_original_seam_was_blocked: The frozen incremental computation was not reusable from an external real consumer under its existing explicit execution-mode contract.
A truthful real path would have required either changing frozen source behavior or duplicating the algorithm; neither was established as a safe implementation seam.
A private internal call would bypass a load-bearing invariant rather than establish a public, typed, authority-bound real boundary.
Real rows could not remain explicitly real under the current executor contract without weakening the frozen semantics.
The canonical hostile review recorded three critical findings, so the prior implementation authorization closed blocked with no later implementation or scientific authority.

options.reason: It would mutate or semantically risk the frozen executor and would make the V0 source bytes no longer the immutable reference. No source refactor is authorized by this decision.
A new, explicitly named seam can be reviewed as one bounded implementation phase with typed authority inputs, exact semantic-equivalence gates, and a hard firewall against scientific execution.
Keep as the terminal disposition if any acceptance gate fails, but the narrow successor has enough architectural value to justify one implementation attempt under the constraints below.

scope: Create one separately named successor seam and its offline verification artifacts.
Expose one public boundary that accepts only a typed authority-bound input envelope and a typed forecast-row batch; raw rows, untyped mappings, and private entrypoints are not admissible inputs.

Keep the frozen V0 executor and all frozen V0 evidence byte-identical; the successor may establish a mechanically equivalent shared computation only if the original frozen bytes remain the immutable oracle and result semantics are preserved.
Preserve valid-result, invalid-input, numerical-runtime, ordering, and failure semantics of the frozen V0 computation; no V2 result contract may stand in for the V0 incremental result contract.
Implement deterministic exactly-once recording with an explicit idempotency key, replay identity, duplicate suppression, and fail-closed conflict handling.
out_of_scope: Scientific evaluation, result production, or claim of validation.
Real data, outcomes, providers, real claims, or evaluation origins; only the bounded ephemeral synthetic ordering fixture is allowed for offline instrumentation.
Any change to JH01, DSH, Router, State, Qnty, or QntySpot.
Any pinning of an expected canonical authorization commit or SHA-256.
Any merge, activation, deployment, live run, or downstream authority.

authority_boundary.implementation_authority_granted: Exactly one future implementation phase with the identity and scope above.
pre_evaluation_prohibitions: Do not read, acquire, interpret, or persist real data or outcomes.
Do not invoke or access any provider.
Real claims and real claim consumption remain prohibited.
Do not create any persistent authorization claim.
Do not read, consume, or advance any evaluation origin.
Do not construct a real-execution authority envelope until a separate evaluation authorization exists.
The only permitted claim-like test object is the explicitly defined ephemeral synthetic ordering fixture; it is not a real claim, is not persisted, is not consumed, and cannot authorize execution.
authority_boundary.required_separate_authorization: A later, separately named scientific evaluation authorization must independently authorize any real input, outcome, provider, claim, or evaluation-origin access. This decision cannot be cited as that authorization.

typed_authority_bound_inputs.construction_rule: Only a validated authority-bound constructor may create the input envelope; a caller cannot select a real mode by string or bypass the envelope with a private call.

claim_before_outcome.fixture_rule: The synthetic fixture is only an ephemeral, non-consuming ordering sentinel; it is not a real claim, is not persisted, and cannot authorize execution.
claim_before_outcome.failure_rule: If authority or the permitted synthetic ordering sentinel is absent, outcome interpretation and result recording must not occur.

deterministic_exactly_once_recording.replay_rule: A byte-identical replay returns the original record identity without a second record.
deterministic_exactly_once_recording.conflict_rule: A same-identity replay with different content fails closed and records no outcome.

entrypoint_and_contract_rules: Use only the public successor boundary; private-entrypoint bypasses are prohibited.
The V0 incremental result contract remains authoritative for equivalence; V2 primitives may not substitute a V2 result contract.
A real row may never be relabeled as SYNTHETIC_VALIDATION to pass a gate.
No implicit fallback, current-materializer laundering, panel substitution, schedule drift, or boundary-date reinterpretation is permitted.

acceptance_gates: The cited predecessor closure remains byte-identical and CLOSED_BLOCKED; PR #239 remains unmerged and is not the implementation under review.
The successor has the exact phase identity above and changes no frozen V0 source, preregistration, evidence, result artifact, JH01, DSH, Router, State, Qnty, or QntySpot artifact.
Static review proves one public typed authority boundary, no private-entrypoint bypass, no V2-contract substitution, and fail-closed rejection of untyped or unauthorized inputs.

Offline synthetic fixtures prove frozen V0 result and failure semantics, including deterministic numerical behavior and invalid-input handling, without accessing real data, outcomes, providers, real claims, or evaluation origins.

Offline instrumentation proves claim-before-outcome ordering using only the permitted ephemeral, non-consuming synthetic ordering fixture: no outcome interpretation or result record is reachable before accepted authority and fixture state; the fixture is not persisted and cannot authorize execution.
Deterministic exactly-once tests prove stable record identity, idempotent replay, duplicate suppression, and fail-closed conflicting replay.
A single hostile review finds no unresolved critical or high issue and produces a terminal closure receipt.
kill_criteria: Any frozen V0 byte, frozen evidence, preregistration, or result-semantic drift.
Any private-entrypoint bypass, V2 result-contract substitution, synthetic relabeling, implicit fallback, or authority laundering.
Any untyped authority input, claim-after-outcome ordering, duplicate record, nondeterministic record, or non-fail-closed conflict.
Any access to real data, outcomes, providers, real claims, or evaluation origins before a separate evaluation authorization; any persistent authorization claim creation or real claim consumption.
Any synthetic ordering fixture persisted, consumed as authorization, treated as a real claim, or used outside offline ordering instrumentation.
Any modification to JH01, DSH, Router, State, Qnty, or QntySpot, or any attempt to pin an expected canonical authorization commit or SHA-256.
Any unresolved critical or high finding at the single review boundary.
On any kill criterion, close the successor phase BLOCKED or ABANDONED; create no scientific authorization and do not reopen it through repair.

one_review_lifecycle.review_type: single hostile review of the bounded successor implementation
one_review_lifecycle.terminal_rule: The first review produces the terminal closure; there is no targeted rereview, repair continuation, automatic reopen, or second implementation phase.
one_review_lifecycle.new_work_rule: Any change to identity, scope, authority, or a killed gate requires a new separately governed decision.

non_authorizations: This decision is not a scientific evaluation authorization.
This decision does not authorize PR #239 or any code from the old consumer-seam authorization.

This decision does not authorize real data access, outcome access, provider access, real claim access, origin consumption, or a downstream trading/execution path; it permits only the bounded ephemeral synthetic ordering fixture for offline instrumentation.
